key_reasoning.reason: Two adjacent presentational components in one directory — JiraCustomFieldsField (inputClassName override) and IndexTypeJira (wrapper spacing div). Single UI layer, no store, API or type changes.

The fix works by overriding global SCSS (fixed height, py-0, truncate on .p-multiselect-label) with !important Tailwind arbitrary variants. Established styling pattern, fully reversible, no security or performance surface — but className-level assertions in the new test are the only guard against a future SCSS change re-clipping the chips.
